name: Anaheim Summer VolunTEEN Program
org: City of Anaheim Community Services Department
what_you_do: Volunteer at summer programs in Anaheim. You can help at day camps, nature camps, libraries and a gym. You earn community service hours.
who_can_apply: Teens 13 to 17 years old. Space is small. Anaheim residents and Anaheim students go first.
pay_detail: Unpaid. You get a letter that confirms your community service hours.
duration: Weeks you choose when you apply
deadline_text: The 2026 applications are closed. Last cycle, applications opened Feb 2, 2026 and closed Apr 10, 2026 at 5 p.m. No late applications were accepted.
how_to_apply: Apply online. You need a TB clearance slip from the last two years. Book a free fingerprint appointment at City Hall. Pick a VolunTEEN orientation date. Choose your program, site and weeks. Sign the waivers.
notes: You pay for your own TB test. Fingerprinting is free. Bring a photo ID to the fingerprint appointment. Last cycle, site assignments were emailed by May 30. Questions: Volunteer Coordinator, 714-765-4994. The city also lists other volunteer jobs for ages 13 and up. Examples are trail work at Oak Canyon Nature Center and youth sports coach assistants.
